Thanks for the ping and the redlines. Quick summary from legal after review (see attached redline): redwood_DPA_redline_v2.docx

1) Retention: Merchantly's 7-year ask is above our standard. Recommend countering with a 3-year retention for personal data and a separate clause for transactional data limited to business necessity; offer to discuss limited exception for regulated records with exec approval.
2) SCCs: We can add the SCC reference language but prefer to map to an Annex that clarifies responsibilities and subprocessors; propose our standard SCC annex to avoid bespoke text.
3) Audit window: decline 10 business days; propose 30 business days to allow scheduling and validation.
4) HIPAA / healthcare language: decline — not applicable to our hosted product unless merchant explicitly processes PHI and executes a HIPAA addendum.

Action items: 
- Priya/Karthik: confirm if Merchantly processes PHI or regulated healthcare data.
- Neha: prepare the SOC2 report + SIG snapshot link for Merchantly's review.
- Commercial: we need Lauren Bishop to approve any retention exception beyond 3 years (commercial/contractual risk).

For signature routing: legal prefers DocuSign envelope with Merchantly as first signer, Redwood as second signer; include the fully executed PDF in HubSpot. If Merchantly requires countersignature offline, advise legal for manual routing.

If you're ok, I'll produce the counter redline and comments for Priya to send back to Sarah.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
